questions.stem: Working from the note above, Read this source excerpt carefully: «Subtract position from length.» After position 1 in a four-note line there are three notes. Identify the value for counting the notes that follow a climax. Compute the value. Report the number.
questions.explanation: Close reading of the note yields this rule: after position 1 in a four-note line there are three notes. The calculation for counting the notes that follow a climax gives 3.
